newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds under pressure from firm dollar.
newsitem.headline: European feeds under pressure from firm dollar.

text.p: European meals and feeds ended Wednesday with interest confined to nearby positions as the firm dollar maintained buyer' reluctance to take on South American products despite being offered slightly lower in the morning.
South American soymeal pellets were earlier offered between unchanged and $4 lower but still failed to spark any trades.
European traders said consumers on the continent were content to continue buying hand-to-mouth, betting that prices would ease in the coming weeks.
"Nobody really wants to know at these levels," one commented. -- Amsterdam Newsroom +31 20 504 5000
